nodes.label: PRJ93 agent-evaluation framework
nodes.rationale: Evaluates the briefing's USEFULNESS, not forecast accuracy (A2 owns MASE/coverage/Winkler). Read-only, LIVE_INGEST off, invents no detection maths; ground truth is triangulated three ways so no single source has to carry the claim.

nodes.label: Synthetic-injection oracle (eval/inject.py)
nodes.rationale: Scaled to an exhaustive, deterministic venue x kind x magnitude x onset x fold x direction grid (N=644) so no RNG seed is needed; the N=4 smoke run is a plumbing self-test, not the citable result.

nodes.label: Human-labelled anchor (eval/labels.py)
nodes.rationale: Schema and labelling CLI shipped with N=0 labels captured, so no actionability aggregate is claimed — the honest state, not a fabricated number.

nodes.label: LLM-as-judge (eval/judge.py)
nodes.rationale: A calibrated proxy reported with its human-agreement kappa, never ground truth; model/rubric/prompt pinned and a pre-registered kappa >= 0.6 threshold decides whether it may scale beyond the labelled days.

nodes.label: Honesty gates G-eval-a..e
nodes.rationale: Synthetic never scored as real; sparse scored on actionability not z; judge reported as a calibrated proxy; every aggregate carries N and a CI; injected windows are held-out folds guarded by assert_no_leakage.

nodes.label: Sensitivity curve — catch rate vs event magnitude
nodes.rationale: The headline, because a large-only detector would still score 1.0 on easy injections; the near-threshold row is the honest hard case.

nodes.label: Alert fatigue + miss:false-alarm cost sweep
nodes.rationale: The surfacing rate on un-injected windows is an UPPER BOUND on weekly false alarms because on real data those items may be genuine; the detector's threshold is fixed, so what the sweep moves is which failure dominates.

nodes.label: Named probes (aged regime-shift, sparse-cluster)
nodes.rationale: Quantify two known judgment calls: an aged shift crosses below a fresh minor item at 13 days, and a clustered Ellel booking escapes the single-day down-weight with x2.07 score inflation. Actionability is deferred to labels/judge, not asserted from z.

nodes.label: VUS-PR detector-level supplement (TSB-AD 1.5)
nodes.rationale: Lag-tolerant, random-robust supplement on the continuous z score, computed by the pinned library and never reimplemented; the system-level battery stays the headline. stock_drawdown excluded — no z signature.

nodes.label: Small-N caveats (Two River Taps closure, Ellel sparsity)
nodes.rationale: Two River Taps is closed after 2026-05-08 so only pre-closure folds are injected; Ellel leaves one short held-out fold and is spike-only — a data limit, not a detector failure.
